title: Mystery Squishy Dumpling Blind Box
description:
Mystery Squishy Dumpling Blind Box is a cute collecting game about mystery boxes, squishy toys and rare dumplings. Open 4 different box types, get random squishy dumplings of different rarity levels and try to complete the full collection.

Each blind box can give you a common, rare, epic or highly valuable dumpling. The more boxes you open, the more chances you have to discover new cute characters and fill every empty slot in your collection. It is a simple, satisfying and relaxing game for fans of blind box toys, squishy fidgets, surprise unboxing, ASMR toys and collectible characters.

Keep opening boxes, hunt rare finds, compare dumplings by rarity and collect them all. Become the ultimate squishy dumpling collector!

title: Ragdoll Fighter
description:
Ragdoll Fighter is a fast, funny 2D physics fighting game where every punch, swing, and stumble is driven by ragdoll physics. Drag your fighter around the arena, build up momentum, and slam into your enemies with fists or weapons until their health hits zero — with satisfying slow-motion on every big hit.

Battle through a campaign of hand-crafted levels, take on multiple foes at once, or test your survival skills in Endless Mode against never-ending waves. Earn coins from powerful hits and combos, then unlock a roster of wild characters — a robot, a ninja, a boxer, a spartan, a pirate, an alien, and more — each with its own attack, defense, and control stats. Collect daily rewards, chase 3-star level clears, and become the last ragdoll standing.

Progression & extras:

Unlock characters in the Character Select screen using coins earned in battle — each has different Attack / Defense / Complexity ratings.
Earn coins from weapon hits, combos, daily login rewards, and optional reward videos.
Daily rewards grow bigger the more days you play in a row.
Options: toggle music and sound, and set your preferred control side.

Features:

Hilarious, unpredictable ragdoll physics combat
Campaign levels with a 3-star rating system
Endless survival mode with escalating difficulty
8 unlockable fighters, each with unique stats and weapons
Intuitive one-finger drag controls — easy to learn, tricky to master
Satisfying slow-motion impacts and combo rewards
Plays great in portrait on desktop and mobile browsers

Win the fight:

Level mode: Defeat every opponent to clear the level. Finish fast and keep your health high to earn up to 3 stars. Clear levels to unlock the next ones.

Endless mode: Survive as long as you can — each kill restores a little health and enemies keep getting tougher. Your score is your kill count.

Don't give up: If you fall, you can watch a short video to revive and jump right back into the fight (once per run).
Manage your health: Keep an eye on the HP bar. When it empties, the round is over.

title: Kick Lucky Block For Brainrot
description:
Throw lucky blocks, train your strength, and collect all the brainrots! Bring on the cheesy weather and enjoy the cheesy brainrots!

Smash rare blocks, collect funny brain creatures, and bring them back to your base. But be careful — every powerful kick can trigger a huge tsunami wave! Run, jump, and survive before the water catches you.

Upgrade your strength, train your legs, buy new weights, and become strong enough to kick blocks even farther. The farther you launch them, the better rewards you can discover!

Features:

- Kick mystery blocks and discover rare rewards
- Survive giant tsunami waves
- Collect brain creatures and place them on your base
- Upgrade your power, speed, and training equipment
- Unlock stronger kicks and reach new areas

title: Funny Finds hidden object game
description: A classic hidden object game. Move around the screen and pay attention to the objects highlighted in the task. Find the required objects on the levels and click on them.

title: Italian Brainrot Find the Difference
description:
Italian Brainrot: Find the Difference is a fast, funny, and bizarre puzzle game where absurdity meets sharp-eyed fun. Each of the 30 levels features two nearly identical images—but with small, sneaky changes hidden in plain sight.

Designed especially for kids, this game brings together cartoon chaos and visual brain-training in a way that’s goofy, creative, and totally unforgettable. You’re not just spotting differences—you’re diving into a wild universe full of absurd characters and hilarious scenes.

🧠 How It Works
30 handcrafted levels with detailed, funny illustrations
Each level has 5 differences to find
No timers, no pressure—perfect for kids and families
Play directly in-browser on mobile or desktop
🎭 Key Characters in the Italian Brainrot Universe
Tralalero Tralala
A three-legged shark always rocking bright Nike sneakers. Whether he's leaping through chaos or fighting with Bombardino Crocodilo, he's full of attitude and absurd energy.

Bombardino Crocodilo
A crocodile-headed creature with the body of a WWII bomber plane. He drops more confusion than bombs and makes every level feel like a fever dream.

Tung Tung
A living, walking wooden drum (inspired by Indonesian bedug) with a baseball bat. While sometimes mistaken as Italian Brainrot, he’s a crossover character who adds international flair to the madness.

Ballerina Cappuccina
A graceful dancer with a cappuccino cup for a head. She pirouettes through scenes of total nonsense, highlighting the game’s charming chaos

title: Get Fat for Brainrot
description: Get Fat for Brainrot is a game where you need to gain a lot of weight for your character to break the dungeon floor and get Brainrots.

title: Obby: Ragdoll Boxing
description:
Immerse yourself in Ragdoll boxing chaos and fun with Obby!

This is a unique simulator that combines ragdoll physics and crazy fights! Here you control not just a fighter, but a real rag doll, who will have to go through trials in the arena, in training and in improvised fights. Funny animation, unpredictable behavior and collision physics turn every fight into an exciting spectacle.

Create your own character, explore locations and prove who is the best boxer among Obby fighters. Control punches, dodge and hit with precise calculation - or just enjoy the chaotic fun, watching your characters fly around the arena.

🔑 Key features of the game:
🥊 Ragdoll physics - every hit is unpredictable
🎮 Simple controls with deep gameplay
🧍 Character customization
🧠 Elements of strategy and reaction
😂 Fun and unexpected situations in every fight
🌍 Various locations and arenas for battles

title: Makeover Mayhem
description: A head-to-head ASMR cleaning duel. You and a rival race to scrub five grimy items back to a sparkling shine — scrape, spray, scrub, and squeegee your way through each one and finish all five before they do (or before the 4-minute timer runs out).

title: BS Simulator
description:
UNLOCK AND UPGRADE BRAWLERS
Unlock and upgrade a variety of Brawlers! Level up your Brawlers and collect unique skins.

TROPHY ROAD
Collect trophies to earn rewards and advance to new leagues!

BRAWL PASS
- More than 140 rewards!
- Complete daily quests and unlock exclusive rewards.

LEADERBOARDS
Compete with real players from all over the world!

DAILY BONUSES
Log in to the game every day and receive exclusive bonuses!

In addition, the game has mini-modes.

title: Mole Dig Clicker
description: Help the mole dig to the center of the world! An idle clicker where you tap to break dirt, buy upgrades, and watch your mole gear up with pickaxes, drills and a cart. Mining keeps going while you're away — claim your dirt when you return. How deep can you get?

title: Funny Rescue Zookeeper
description: Amia had a bad day today at the zoo. As a zookeeper, Amia is responsible for taking care of all the animals there. Only today, things did not go as they should and Amia had a quite serious accident. Let's treat Amia so that she can return to take care of her beloved animals.

title: Brainrot Mixup
description:
Brainrot Puzzle takes the viral brainrot animal aesthetic and turns it into an actually playable, satisfying, and replayable puzzle game — perfect for mobile, casual web, or PC.

If you love quirky puzzle games, if you’ve laughed at “banana chimpanzee” memes, or if you just want to rot your brain a little in between serious games — this one’s for you.

title: BitBanda
description:
BitBanda is your music studio in your pocket! No instrument skills needed: just tap the sound cards, and cheerful musicians take the stage and start playing together. All the sounds are pre-matched in rhythm and key, so playing badly is impossible. From the very first tap, you create a real track!

Feel like a true DJ: control the volume of each musician, trigger solos, tweak effects (filter, echo, reverb), build your track from scenes, and arrange your mix. Hunt for secret sound combinations — they unlock bonuses and turn the stage into a real party!

title: Funny Ear Surgery
description: You are acting a professional ear doctor here to help people get rid of their ear problems. Now you must help our another cute patient with her ear problems. Be patience and enjoy it!

title: Sausage Life
description:
Avoid obstacles and become the last sausage standing.
A parkour and survival game where you, as a sausage, must compete for survival.
As you progress through the game, you'll unlock various unique skins.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?

A: The game is a mix of parkour and survival for a sausage.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?

A: The game offers fun gameplay, unique skins referencing movies and games, like Harley Quinn.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: Yes, the game has currency - money, which can be spent on skins and rebirth.

Q: What is the progression system like? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Progress by surviving levels in the role of a sausage.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: What are the engaging elements of content (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game offers many skins with references to movies and games, like Harley Quinn.

Economy & Customization

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can players adjust the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, players can buy hats or weapons for their character.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in gameplay without sound?

A: The music complements the game well but is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Funny Dentist Surgery
description: Leah has always had a sweet tooth. She loves candies, ate them a bunch, and end up with some horrible teeth problems now. Help fix her teeth problems. You can also decorate her teeth at the end with funny stickers!

title: No Shorts
description:
🌟 Welcome to the exciting world of ragdoll physics and creative fun in the style of short videos in the game No Shorts! 📱 Quickly switch between levels with swipes, just like in your favorite social networks. ⚡️ Use various tools to interact with ragdoll stickmen and activate objects on the stage. Create your own playgrounds in the level designer! 🛠️

🎮 Fans of physics-based sandboxes and creative simulators will definitely love this new trendy game!

🎲 Game features:
👆Simple one-finger control: Click to interact with the stickmen and the environment.
🌈Simple and funny casual graphics. 
🤸‍♂️Addictive gameplay with unique ragdoll physics. 
📱💻Play online from PC or mobile phone anytime and anywhere. 
🏗️Level builder where you can create your own game stories and scenarios. 

⭐️ Hurry up and click "Play" and don't forget to leave a review to help us improve the game!

title: Close Ads
description:
A fast chaos arcade game where your only goal is simple: close ads.
But every few levels, the ads become more annoying.

title: Splatcha!
description:
Splatcha! is a fast-paced local multiplayer party game where colorful blob rivals battle for paint-covered supremacy. Race against the clock in frantic 90-second matches, splashing every inch of the arena with your color while outsmarting your opponent. Play head-to-head on a single keyboard or sharpen your skills against AI opponents with three distinct difficulty levels: Chill, Rival, and Demon.

Master five wildly interactive arenas featuring spinning candy mixers, bouncing beach parasols, teleport portals, rising tides that erase paint, and a stormy castle packed with surprises. Turn the tide with explosive power-ups, speed boosts, shields, clones, storms, and more, while golden treasure chests and sudden-death overtime keep every match unpredictable. Arcade Series mode adds extra replayability with quick-fire challenges and escalating chaos.

With vibrant visuals, accessible controls, hilarious couch co-op action, and enough confetti to celebrate every victory, Splatcha! is the perfect competitive game for friends, families, and anyone who loves fast, colorful multiplayer battles full of strategy and fun.

title: Gibbets: Bow Master
description:
Gibbets: Bow Master is a fun and challenging online game where players must use their archery skills to save people from being hanged. The game features various levels, each with a different set of challenges and obstacles that players must overcome.
In each level, players must use their bow and arrow to cut the rope holding up a person who has been hanged. However, players must be careful not to accidentally hit the person they are trying to save, as this will result in a game over. To make things even more challenging, players must also navigate various obstacles such as wind, moving platforms, and blocks, all while trying to make the perfect shot.

title: Let's Fart Brandon
description:
Let's Fart Brandon: Browser is a free funny action/comedy game featuring Mr Biden and his infamous farts.

The Story: Mr. Biden falls asleep at a conference and has nightmares. In the world of his nightmare, his only weapon is fart.

Game Features:
Funny top down actin horror/comedy gameplay
Easy to pick up and play
For fans of fun and comedy games
Suitable for both female and male players
Good graphic with stable performance on older PCs
Unique surreal nightmare world with sense of humor

title: House Builder
description: House Builder is a very simple online game where you won’t be tasked with any super complicated tasks. Right at the start of the game, you will be presented with an empty space where you’ll be able to build the building of your dreams. Start with the walls that have to have the correct shape and form. After that, you can start putting in accessories and furniture. Add tables, chairs, sofas, flowers, etc. You can also buy other buildings and decorate them to your liking. It’s all up to you! So come on, let’s play!

title: Count Masters
description: Count Masters is an interesting online game that is also available on mobile devices. It offers unique gameplay where your main objective will be to defeat your opponents and avoid obstacles in the process. It’s interesting in a sense that your army can only get larger by walking through a gate. The number written on the gate signifies the number by which your army will grow larger. Pick the right gate so that you get as many warriors as possible. You will need the warriors to defeat all of your enemies. So be sure to try the game out!

title: Pen Run
description: In this game, you will be controlling a pen that you are tasked with getting to the finish line. There will be numerous obstacles waiting for you on the way that can stop you and end the game. Start playing and avoid them all! The game is offering you a fairly small playing field, so you won’t have much space to navigate through. Start playing and show everyone what you’ve got. Scout the whole level.

title: Hole Run 3D
description: Hole Run 3D is a simple online game with a singular goal. You have to suck up all of the objects ahead of you so that the ball doesn’t touch anything. The first levels will be simple, but as the number of obstacles grows larger and larger, the game will get more and more difficult. If it touches anything, the ball will fall apart and you’ll have to start the level again. Since the levels are generated automatically, their number is infinite. You can play the game for a long time before it starts to bore you.

title: Backflip Maniac
description: Backflip Maniac is great online game, where you'll be jumping with your character. The first levels will be fairly easy, since you won’t be jumping from the highest buildings just yet. As you progress, the levels will get progressively higher. It’s very important to hit the red target, else you won’t be able to move to the next level. The controls can be a bit difficult for some, at the start, but you will adapt in the long run. Overall, the game offers you great gameplay, 3D graphics and 30 levels. So come on, let’s play!

title: Turbo Race 3D
description: Turbo Race 3D is a fun online game where you'll be able to enjoy quick races. You will be controlling a character riding a bike. You can drive slower or faster, whichever option you need at the moment. The goal is to collect as many coins as possible and to become the star of the race. To do so, you'll have to avoid all of the obstacles that you find on the way. You should also try to pick up any turbo that you see on the playing field. The controls are rather simple and all you need to do is move it from one side to the other. Good luck!

title: Water Slide 3D
description: Water Slide 3D is a great online game that you can play and slide down many great water slides. The goal of the game is to collect as many coins and special items that you can. Try to dodge all of the different obstacles that could endanger your life. You have a limited number of lives, so be really careful. Aside from that, you can also come across a surf that you can ride for a while. You can use the earned coins to unlock new characters or items, like glasses for instance. Will you be able to get through all of the levels on your first try? So jump on your bike and have fun!

title: SlidePark.io
description: SlidePark.io is a fun online game where you’ll be racing on a water slide. There are 20 enemies in front of your that you’ll need to get through so that you can finish first. You don’t need to worry the slide is long enough to accommodate that. You simply need to dodge everyone. If you crash into them, you will move them in front of you and you don’t want to do that. You can try a trick, when you get to the edge of the slide, you can jump down and shorten your way. But you need to aim precisely, since if you miss, the game ends for you. So good luck!

title: Touchdown!
description: Touchdown! is a funny online game where you’ll be playing American football. Your objective is to get as many points as you can and thus defeat your opponent. You can only do that by scoring a touchdown. You need to get the ball to the end of the playing field. Move around the playing field in such a way that you get the ball from your opponent or protect the ball in your possession. If you have a friend nearby, you can both play on one PC. It’s much more fun and you can see who the better player is. The game offers simple gameplay and pixelated 2D graphics that you’ll surely love. Come try the game out!

title: Maze Cube
description: Maze Cube is a reflex focused game where you’ll be trying to get your ball into the maze and then out again. The problem is that you can only move forwards and there’s no way of stopping. Aside from that you cannot touch any of the walls of the maze, else the game ends and you’ll have to start again. The game has a single goal for you, to stay alive and to earn as many points as you can. Aside from that you can also try to pick up diamonds on your way. The graphics is really minimalistic, so don’t expect anything stellar. So come on, let’s play!

title: Cat Runner
description: Today, we’re presenting you a great 3D game, where you’ll be running around city streets with a cat. Your objective will be to pick up bones and to dodge individual obstacles. Aside from static obstacles, you’ll also have to avoid gigantic rats or mad dogs. If you touch any of your enemies, the game will take one heart away from you. You have a total of three lives, so take care. You can also try to complete many different missions that will reward you with a price once you succeed!
